summary: Short kerb at a junction gore beside the arterial; no room to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Junction with a fast food site and a house about 18 m off; fully exposed.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs along a slip lane beside painted chevrons; no pull-off, only one car at the gore.
drivers.convention: No sign of parking along this kerb; just a car caught at the gore.

flags: Painted chevron markings at the section
sun_shade: Open to the sky; trees to the west and south-west.
